name: Mahou Senshi Symphonic Knights 2 ~Otome no Megami no Koukyoukyoku~
original_name: 魔法戦士シンフォニックナイツ2 ～乙女と女神の交響曲～
source:
The Symphonic Knights are magical warriors who continue fighting against evil threats that endanger the peace of the people.

Before them appears their former nemesis, Falke. The two Symphonic Knights are shaken by Falke’s brutal rampage, even though he was supposed to have already left the path of evil behind.

Then, before them, another Symphonic Knight appears. She calls herself Symphonic Spica. Just who is this mysterious magical warrior, Symphonic Spica—and what is Falke’s true identity?

Will the Symphonic Knights be able to overcome the battle against their own pasts… and seize the future?

[From the official website]
translation:
交响乐骑士是魔法战士，他们继续与危害人民和平的邪恶威胁作斗争。

在他们面前出现了他们以前的宿敌法尔克。尽管法尔克本应已经远离邪恶之路，但他的残酷暴行却让两名交响骑士感到震惊。

然后，在他们面前，又出现了另一位交响骑士。她称自己为“交响角角宿”。这位神秘的魔法战士交响乐·斯皮卡到底是谁——法尔克的真实身份又是什么？

交响骑士能否战胜自己的过去……并抓住未来？
